name: paperless-sync-eslint
description: ESLint, which scripts/eslint.sh runs on the JavaScript of the app, of its tests and of its scripts with the rules of eslint.config.mjs; nothing of it ships in the package of the app
//: The override: ESLint asks for minimatch 10, and only 11.0.1 and newer are free of the advisory GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249. minimatch.test.mjs holds the lock file to it and shows that ESLint works with it; drop the override when ESLint asks for a fixed minimatch itself.
